text:
alex: Hey — noticed a regression after last nights routing tweak. New warmup seems to be adding ~200ms on first 10s of a websocket session and quota spikes for some tenants. Anyone else seeing this?

maria: I saw errors in the console: a bunch of 429s right at session start, looks correlated with streaming inflight windows.

kevin: Confirmed on staging, warmup multiplier went from 0.2 -> 0.5 in the rollout config. That was to reduce cold-start token thrash but maybe overshot.

sam: Is this the change from the router policy that routes to the 'high-throughput' pool for new sessions? Could be double-counting credits during warmup.

vijay: deploy-bot just recorded canary v3 -> v4 at 02:12 UTC. Canary metrics showed a small latency bump but not flagged.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for routing-policy/v4 on 10% of traffic.

alex: Right — we route new sessions to high-throughput for first minute while KV cache warms. The new warmup multiplier increases allowed inflight tokens which appears to trigger quota meter faster.

maria: Telemetry gaps: our dashboard aggregates token-usage at 1m resolution, so the initial spike smears into quota alarms. We need finer early-window metrics. Suggest adding a p95 10s sliding metric for session-start token bursts.

kevin: Short term: revert multiplier to 0.25? Or gate the multiplier by tenant quota tier so small tenants don't hit hard.

sam: Revert is safest. But we should also tweak metering: don't charge burst until session stabilizes for 5s. That requires changing the metering rpc to mark "warmup=true" then apply delayed accounting.

vijay: Adding warmup flag might impact billing accuracy. Maybe add a temporary grace credit: each session gets X free tokens the first 10s, shown in console as "warmup credit". Ops can tune per-customer.

alex: I like grace credit idea if we can make it transparent on the Console and in usage logs. Customers will be less upset.

maria: For telemetry, we'll emit session_start_burst_tokens and session_warmup_duration. Then dashboards can show 'fraction of sessions that used warmup credit'.

kevin: Small patch ready: config diff to roll back multiplier and add warmup-credit=500 tokens for tier<=standard. Pushing to canary now.

deploy-bot: Rollout updated: routing-policy/v4 canary config changed.

sam: Also need to update the alerting rule: current "token_rate > X for 5m" should ignore the initial 30s of a session surge. Otherwise we'll get noise.

vijay: Agree — add a pre-filter: only trigger if surge persists after warmup_duration OR if the number of concurrent sessions > threshold.

alex: Action items: (1) revert multiplier in canary (kevin), (2) implement warmup-credit metric + emit session_start_burst_tokens (maria), (3) add Console toggle to show warmup credits per tenant (product/console followup), (4) update alerts to avoid warmup noise (sam). I'll file a postmortem note after we stabilize.

maria: I'll add a tiny dashboard panel with 10s resolution and wire the new metric to grafana alert preview.

kevin: Patch deployed to canary, monitoring for 10m then propagate.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout at 10% -> health: healthy (10m).

sam: Early signs look good, 429s dropped on the canary slice.

alex: Great. If stable over 30m let's roll to 50% and schedule console UX work next sprint. :thumbsup:

vijay: Will draft the customer-facing blurb for any tenants who saw quota blips.

maria: Logging note: add a session.warmup=true tag so we can filter logs easily.

kevin: Created PR for warmup-credit metrics and multiplier revert: https://git.internal/r/1234

alex: Thanks team — keeping this thread pinned until postmortem written.

sam: One more thought — long-term we should evaluate per-route warmup profiles, some routes (embeddings/long-context) need longer KV warming. We can make the warmup window route-configurable.

alex: Noted. Booking a short sync tomorrow to sketch route-config schema.
